source_title: An Unusual Presentation of Richter's Transformation of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia in Liver and Lung on 18F-FDG PET/CT
disease_label_per_paper: Richter's transformation of chronic lymphocytic leukemia presenting in liver and lung
presentation_summary: Known chronic lymphocytic leukemia in remission for six years
Presented with fever and weight loss
Laboratory examination showed hemoglobin 9 g/dL, white blood cell count 13 x10^9/L, and LDH 312 U/L with reference 100-190 U/L
18F-FDG PET/CT showed intensely FDG-avid liver lesions and a solitary lung nodule, without lymphadenopathy
PET/CT-directed liver lesion biopsy showed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, suggestive of Richter transformation
The patient received rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone with significant clinical improvement
